name: Web Design & Development
tagline: Fast, mobile-first websites that turn visitors into customers.
intro: We design and build conversion-focused websites — clean, fast-loading and mobile-first — engineered to rank on Google and convert Goa's visitors into paying customers.
deliverables: Fast-loading pages tuned for Core Web Vitals
valueProps: Sites built to load in under 3 seconds on mobile data
Designed around your customer's booking or enquiry journey
Easy-to-edit content so you stay in control

process.text: We map your services, customers and competitors.
We craft a layout around your key conversion goal.
We develop a fast, responsive, SEO-ready site.
We go live, track performance and iterate.

pricing.note: one-time, packages scale with pages & features

faqs.q: How long does a website take to build?
faqs.a: A standard business website typically goes live in 2–4 weeks, depending on the number of pages and content readiness.

faqs.q: Will my website work on mobile?
faqs.a: Yes. Every site we build is mobile-first and tested across phones, tablets and desktops — essential when most Goa searches happen on mobile.

faqs.q: Do you provide hosting?
faqs.a: Yes, we can host your site on Sanctify Hostings with SSL, backups and support, or deploy to your preferred host.

name: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
tagline: Rank higher on Google and win local searches.
intro: Our SEO service gets your business found on Google when local customers search — through technical fixes, local optimisation, content and quality link-building that compound month after month.
deliverables: Local SEO & Google Business Profile optimisation
Keyword research mapped to buyer intent
valueProps: Focus on high-intent keywords that bring buyers, not just traffic
Local pack & Google Maps visibility for nearby searches
Transparent reporting so you see exactly what's working

process.text: We diagnose technical, on-page and local issues.
We prioritise keywords by intent and opportunity.
We optimise, publish and build authority.
We track rankings, traffic and leads monthly.

pricing.note: per month, based on competition & scope

faqs.q: How long until I see SEO results?
faqs.a: Local SEO improvements often show within 2–3 months, with stronger, compounding results from 6 months as authority builds.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee #1 rankings?
faqs.a: No credible agency can guarantee a specific position, since Google controls rankings. We do commit to proven, white-hat methods and measurable progress.

faqs.q: What is local SEO?
faqs.a: Local SEO optimises your presence for location-based searches so you appear in Google Maps and the local pack when nearby customers search.

name: Google Ads & PPC (SEM)
tagline: Get qualified leads fast with high-ROI paid search.
intro: We plan, launch and optimise Google Ads campaigns that put your business at the top of search results instantly — targeting ready-to-buy customers and maximising every rupee of your budget.
valueProps: Appear at the top of Google from day one
Pay only when someone clicks your ad
Full conversion tracking so you know cost-per-lead

process.text: We define goals, audiences and budget.
We structure campaigns and write ads.
We refine bids, keywords and targeting.
We double down on what delivers leads.

pricing.note: per month management, plus your ad budget

faqs.q: What budget do I need for Google Ads?
faqs.a: It depends on your industry and competition. Many Goa businesses start with a modest daily budget and scale up as we prove cost-per-lead.

faqs.q: How is this different from SEO?
faqs.a: Google Ads delivers instant visibility through paid placements, while SEO builds long-term organic rankings. They work best together.

faqs.q: Do you manage the ad spend too?
faqs.a: Yes. We manage bids and budgets to maximise ROI, and report exactly where your spend goes.

name: Social Media Marketing
tagline: Grow your brand and following on Instagram & Facebook.
intro: We manage your social media end-to-end — content, creatives, posting and paid campaigns — to build a loyal following and turn engagement into enquiries for your Goa business.
valueProps: Consistent, on-brand content without the daily effort
Creatives designed to stop the scroll and drive action
Paid + organic working together for reach and leads

process.text: We define voice, pillars and posting cadence.
We design posts, reels and captions.
We schedule, post and engage daily.
We boost top content with paid ads.

pricing.note: per month, by platforms & post volume

faqs.q: Which platforms should my business be on?
faqs.a: It depends on your audience. For most Goa businesses Instagram and Facebook drive the best results; we recommend platforms based on where your customers actually are.

faqs.q: Do you create the content too?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle strategy, design, captions and posting — you simply approve the calendar.

faqs.q: Can you run paid social ads?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We combine organic content with targeted Instagram and Facebook ad campaigns for maximum reach and leads.

name: Graphic Design & Branding
tagline: Standout logos, branding & creatives that get noticed.
intro: From logos and brand identity to social creatives, brochures and packaging, our design team crafts visuals that make your Goa business look professional and memorable.
valueProps: A consistent, professional look across every touchpoint
Designs tailored to your industry and audience
Fast turnarounds with unlimited-round options

process.text: We understand your brand and goals.
We present initial design directions.
We iterate to perfection with your feedback.
We hand over all print & digital files.

faqs.q: Do I get all the source files?
faqs.a: Yes. You receive editable and print-ready files, so you fully own your brand assets.

faqs.q: How many revisions are included?
faqs.a: Our packages include multiple revision rounds so we get the design exactly right for your brand.

faqs.q: Can you match my existing brand?
faqs.a: Definitely. We can work within your current guidelines or help you refresh and modernise them.

name: Content Marketing
tagline: Content that builds authority and drives organic traffic.
intro: We create blogs, videos and email content that attract, educate and convert your audience — building long-term authority and a steady stream of organic traffic for your Goa business.
valueProps: Content mapped to what your customers are searching for
Builds trust and authority that compounds over time
Fuels your SEO, social and email channels together

process.text: We find topics your audience searches for.
We produce SEO-optimised, on-brand content.
We publish across web, social and email.
We track engagement and refine topics.

faqs.q: How does content marketing help my business?
faqs.a: Quality content answers your customers' questions, builds trust, improves SEO rankings and gives you material to share across every channel.

faqs.q: Do you write the content in-house?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team researches, writes and optimises content tailored to your industry and audience.

faqs.q: How often should I publish?
faqs.a: Consistency matters more than volume. For most businesses a steady cadence of 4–8 quality pieces a month works well.

name: Email & Bulk SMS Marketing
tagline: Direct campaigns that reach customers instantly.
intro: Reach your customers directly with targeted email and bulk SMS campaigns — perfect for offers, bookings, reminders and re-engagement that drive repeat business.
valueProps: Reach customers directly in their inbox and pocket
Ideal for offers, bookings and seasonal promotions
High ROI channel that drives repeat business

process.text: We build and segment your contact lists.
We craft compelling emails and SMS copy.
We schedule and deliver campaigns.
We test and improve open & click rates.

faqs.q: Is bulk SMS still effective?
faqs.a: Yes. SMS boasts very high open rates and is excellent for time-sensitive offers, booking reminders and alerts to local customers.

faqs.q: Do you provide the contact database?
faqs.a: We help you build and grow a permission-based list; we don't use purchased spam lists, which harm your brand and deliverability.

faqs.q: Can campaigns be automated?
faqs.a: Yes. We set up automated welcome, reminder and follow-up sequences that run without manual effort.

name: Local Listings & Online Classifieds
tagline: Get found across Google, Maps & every major directory.
intro: We list and optimise your business across Google, Maps and the top classifieds and directories — building the consistent citations that boost local rankings and bring in nearby customers.
valueProps: Consistent listings that boost local search rankings
Show up on Google Maps when customers are nearby
More calls, directions and enquiries from local searchers

process.text: We find and fix inconsistent listings.
We create optimised profiles everywhere.
We tune categories, photos and keywords.
We build reviews and monitor rankings.

pricing.note: per month, by number of directories

faqs.q: Why do consistent listings matter?
faqs.a: Search engines trust businesses with consistent name, address and phone details across the web — it directly improves local rankings and customer confidence.

faqs.q: Will this help me appear on Google Maps?
faqs.a: Yes. Optimising your Google Business Profile and citations is the core of ranking in Google Maps and the local pack.

faqs.q: Do you manage reviews too?
faqs.a: We set up systems to generate and monitor reviews, which are a major local ranking and trust factor.
